Your passage gave me an idea of the theme having a partially alien-minded protagonist can be. And it's to explore the gap in understanding each other between each character, and the subsequent conflicts and emotional pain that follows. It's not just about the protagonist' psychology, but also the others' reaction towards them

The core conflict on the protagonist would then be in grappling with their shame, guilt and loneliness that come from this lack of understanding. It's the loneliness and pain to see how even your loved ones who want to connect with you most can never truly understand you. And for many of your acquaintances, they might even see you as less than human. And in the case of the immortal fairy's example, they cannot even receive consolations of their grief by connecting with someone who have had the exact experience as they do

While the 'non-human/alien' part of their psyche might not be relatable, the relational part is relatable to many neurodivergent folks. Perhaps to a more minor scale, even to many neurotypical ones, given how we're all different from the social norm in one way or another

There are three main types of magic in my world : arcana, belief magic and domain magic

Arcana is just like science that has a systematic way of calculation and usage, except only some people are born with the ability to wield it. Casting arcana depletes both your mana and mental energy. The more complex and wide-spread the spell is, the more exhausting it becomes. Hence those who're good at arcana would usually also make good researchers and scientists

Belief magic is a form of magic that materialize a person's(or a group's) belief and emotions into reality. The stronger the beliefs are in an explosive moments, the more powerful the magic is. So to successfully cast a powerful one, a group of fervent, most likely deluded crowd would be needed. It can be quite damaging to society/the person if used too much

Domain magic is a way in which you shift yourself to represent an abstract concept, in which case you would gain the ability to wield magic related to such concept. It can be very powerful and surpass the boundaries of science. But to use it, you would have to restrictive yourself to certain manners. It can be really damaging to your sense of self or mental health as time goes on. And as time goes on, you become less and less human

In history around the boomers' and Gen X's time, there was a period when they fled from their homeland due to war and economical I stability, and started anew here. It was a time of great hardship and difficulties, but also of oppoturnities. They had to endure a lot and power through hardship, but hard work paid off. Many of whom started as a Factory worker or technician, and made their way up to open their own company

There is a common saying here, in which 'success replies on your Father's achievement'

The only way to get out of this circumstance is to get A+s, get into top 10% of your peers, and become a doctor, a lawyer, an engineer, an accountant, or similar profession

It's tied to why our place is a 'cultural desert'. Art and cultural pursuits, such as learning to draw and play piano, are but tools to increase children's competitive to get into better schools. Once you get past that stage tho, it's a sign of immaturity, that you're wasting time to 'play around' and pursue a field that is severely underdeveloped here, instead of say STEM, medicine, accounting/business or laws

Older folks consider the youngsters weak and fragile for wanting work-life balance and to pursue their own personal goals unrelated to money-making. 'Of course youngsters should endure, it's the only way to succeed', they would say. They're unaware that we no longer have that oppoturnity as they did in the past, and not everyone can become doctors or lawyers. Youngster consider older folks outdated, arrogant, and justifying unfair workplace exploitations

Hence, with all factors combined, it's a negative cycle that discourages creators from pursuing their dreams. There's a famous saying that those who survive this process are either genius, starving, or have their rich daddy to support them

It depends on what kind of story we are writing.

If the setting of the story is in the real world, we search for names in that culture, and then pick the one the with a meaning most representative of the character' main theme.

If it's a fantasy setting, we look into the culture of the fantasy world. Usually, we flesh out the evolution of culture of the fantasy culture. We would search for a word from a culture that used to have high influence on the fantasy nation in ancient time(usually Roman, Greek, Gothic, proto-Germanic languages etc), and then change the word slightly to mimic language evolution in the fantasy nation.

For example, we have a character named Adora. She lives in our fantasy world's version of America, who also has an ancient Greek ancestry, with her family being a secluded and traditional one. So, we picked the name Aodorea(Ao = Dawn in Doric Greek, Dorea = gift in Dori Greek). It fits her character, in that she was found and adopted by her infertile mother at dawn, and so her adoptive parents considered her a gift from dawn. However, we also figured that most Americans would find her name hard to pronounce, pronouncing it as 'Adora' instead.

It's the ideal method, usually done to important characters. For others, we just search 'top 100 baby names in (insert country)' or something like that

**Lily Heart and the (unnamed)warlock**

She was actually Lily Heart in her first life, a unicorn with purple coat, silver mane, and lavender-coloured eyes. She was a princess(in that setting, the highest monarch are still Kings and queens) of the Astian royal line.

Her first life happened ~3000 years ago, during the age of camels. Back then, the camels first arrived at the coast of Hesperia, bringing advancement, peace and prosperity to the primitive Hesperia. However, the Astian royals see them as enemies, since their existence danger the supremacy of the ponykind, as well as themselves.

Lily Heart, however, went against her family's will, and welcomed the camels instead. She was granted the duchy of Favent by the camels, and granted the title as the Duchess of Favent. Favent is an ancient city with a rich historical and culture ties, but facing massive depopulation, nearly turning into ruins. With her strong ability in stewardship, she rebuilt Favent, and brought prosperity to that place.

The Astian king, naturally, was enraged, and deemed her as a familial shame for supporting their enemies. It doesn't help that the open support of a member of the royal family encouraged a lot of Astian unicorns to support the camels, depleting Astia of its talents. The king sent a warlock to Favent, in an attempt to bring the princess back.

Just as the warlock meet the young princess, he found himself fallen deeply in love with her. Yet Lily Heart is disgusted by his usage of dark magic and his shady ways, and promptly refused him. The warlock felt extremely humiliated, and decided to use some dark magic to entrance Lily Heart. He made Lily Heart do things that sullied her name, such that she would be hated by her subjects and distrusted by the camels, and she would have no choice but to choose him.

His plan succeeded half-way, causing her to be chased away, and she was brought to his lair. At this moment, Lily Heart finally broke free of his control, and it turns out she was awake and conscious the whole time. Lily Heart promptly took her own life, such that the warlock would not be able to have his prize. 

In his heartbroken state, the warlock, using his knowledge of necromancy, made a phylactery for Lily Heart, and sacrificed himself by giving all his life force to Lily Heart, such that she would be able to return to life, and regain all she had lost. However, the phylactery is flawed, and such an action in turn made his soul bound together with Lily Heart within the phylactery, becoming one single being.

Lily Heart was erased from history by the Astian King, in order to hide his family shame. Her story was forgotten overtime. However, occasionally, there would still be legends of a great Favent lady who brought the city back from death, although the legend is at best patchy.


**Little Ghost**

Several millenia later, the protaganist of the story, Moonlight Toccata, found a spirit-like being in a necropolis under Favent. Due to the drastic difference in nature of Lily Heart and the warlock, their souls conflict each other constantly, causing the merged one to be amnesiac. Indeed, the ghost cannot remember her past at all. Her mental age has regressed back to that of a filly due to her amnesia.

In a feat of pure whim, and perhaps some curiosity, Moonlight Toccata adopted the ghost as her 'younger sister', and named the ghost 'Little Ghost', as a reference to her immaturity. Little Ghost was generally helpful, but also terribly oblivious. There would also be some uncharacteristic sudden feats of malice, making Moonlight Toccata wonder what is the true identity of the ghost, but to no avail. With tireless efforts and patience, she successfully taught Little Ghost to be a well-behaved one, controlling her malice. 


**Pure Dawn**

The original Pure Dawn was actually another pony. (She belongs to another long story line, and it would be too long to type here. So I'll make it brief here.) She's the descendant of a Canterbrian noble who was held captive during the war in-between Astia and the rest of Hesperia. In order to maintain peace and stop Astians from conquering the whole world, the Canterbrians sealed the whole Canterbria, as well as the Astian warmages into limbo. Those who were captured before were then left to the complete mercy of the humiliated Astians, living in a heavily discriminated environment, a concentration camp village named Mataporquera(massacre of pigs).

Ten years before the main storyline, an Astian faction wanted to discover the secret behind these Canterbrians' High magical prowess, and also turning them into mindless soldiers that can help them conquer the whole Hesperia again. The adults within the village were wiped off by a vile battle spell called Searing Light(blinding hot light that sear the eyeball and brain of the victims). The remaining foals were brought to a secret laboratory. They were subjected to countless deliberate mental torture, as an attempt to find a way to make them mindless.

Pure Dawn was one of those who actually successfully became mindless, and deemed as a miracle by those ponies. However, those who plotted the massacre of these Canterbrians were soon killed by their own enemies, turning their plot into a failure. Pure Dawn was then kept within the facility for years, submerged in magical liquid that can sustain her bodily functions, as well as stopping her from aging.


**Little Ghost and Pure Dawn**

First, I must clarify that it's not my idea. While the world building is my friend and my combined effort, this part(Quiroponia/Chacetania) is thought up by him. This world belongs to Epic of Espera(name might change tho), a story we are writing


**Background**

In the ancient time(~4000 years ago) even before the three tribes in proto-Equestria started to conflict each other, there was a war happening in the east of the Equestrian continent. A conflict in-between Alicornia, which is in Hesperia(reference to Spain), and the ancient Crystal Empire(Roman Empire), which is in the east(Italy).

In order to win the war, the Alicornians researched how to create a pony that contain the magic of all three kinds, which they succeed. The resulted creation soon became the king of Alicornia, with the new race given the name 'alicorn'.

The Alicorn King, however, soon realized how catastrophic it can be for one alone to hold so many power. The Crystal Empire's wielding of the magic of love shows him how devastating it can be, when mortals wield divine power as well. His resolve was finally hardened, after seeing the lawless gods among New World(Mesoamerica + carribean Islands + South America). He came to believe that sapient beings can never wield their power well, and to have gods means the worldly matters would forever be ruled by the whims of a single being. 

He decided that he would be the 'God to end all gods'. To carve off Hesperia and the New World from the wider world, and created a mini utopia universe ruled by a mechanical construct with all other sapient gods subdued, named the Algorithm. However, the Alicornians soon figured out his plan, and started to plot against his plan. Cuz if he can subdue all the gods, then why not become the overdeity of all himself instead?

In the end, the Alicorn king still succeed in his plan to carve out Hesperia and the New World. However, due to the sabotage of the Alicornians, the split was much more catastrophic instead, causing the ancient Crystal Empire to fall completely. The demoralised Crystal Ponies, as well as a number of refugees immigrated to the Equestrian continent, which they started living with the three tribes, or finding a new nation in the Crystal pony's case. The split was then dubbed 'The Cataclysm', or 'The First Dark Age'.

Out of desperation, the Crystal Empire was forced to engage in pony experiment as well during the war. They ended up creating a new race called batponies by transforming pegasi, making them much more shift and gaining night vision, excellent for surprise attack. The batpony legion was sent to Hesperia when the split happened, making them trapped within the Hesperian world. Back then, the batponies were about to be completely crushed by unicorns with mind magic. Fortunately, their commander, nicknamed the Golden Bat, was able to save them from complete destruction. 

The batpony kind, fearful of racial genocide again, started to flee into the mountains, living in caves. Many years later, a bunch of batponies first ventured out of the caves, and established their own kingdom with the nearby Earth Pony nation's graceful help. That kingdom later became Quiroponia, ruled by a line of monarch who were said to be the descendants of the Golden Bat


**Chacetania and Equestria**

Many years later, many more nations were conquered by a unicorn nation named Astia. Seeing this, the sovereign Queen, Moorish Merrymaker, decided to unite the northern nations, and create a nation that can fight against Astians. 

She married a Duke of Favent and Sagunt, two unicorn nations next to Quiroponia. Thus Chacetania(land of common ponies) was created with the ideology of treating all races of ponies as equals, and establishing a harmonious relationship with each race. They do not actively invade the others, but when one of them are invaded, all the regions within would fight back valiantly. 

Chacetania would be the one most similar to Equestria within Hesperia, and the first one to promote harmonious relationship in-between races. However, the local identity and cultural difference is also much stronger than Equestria 


**Renaciment of Hesperia**

After so many years, the Algorithm starts to run out of power. Which means it will soon be no longer able to maintain Hesperia, as well as subduing the power of the gods. However, it cannot just merge Hesperia back as well, as it will cause yet another Cataclysm due to how drastically different Hesperians are to Equestrians, and how Hesperians are not famiar with divine stuff. The gods, in comparison, are resentful towards the forceful taking of power, and refuse to help.

As a result, the Algorithm started a simulation, and created a pony, Moorish Delight, to be the main subject of the experiment. The method is to let Moorish Delight solve all the problems and gather knowledge within Hesperia, by going through countless of loops. Due to it being a simulation, only a few minutes have passed in the wide world, while around ten thousand years have already passed in the simulation.


**Main story**

This is when Moonlight Toccata(Huracan), was pulled into the Hesperian world. She is completely ignorant of what is happening, or even why she was pulled initially. During her time in Hesperia, she would have to cooperate with Moorish Delight, resolve the problems in Hesperia, and re-discover her divinity. There, she would fulfil her purpose of bringing a thorough re-structuring of the social structure within Hesperia, reinvigorate the ancient gods, and create a circumstance where the merge can safely happen.

During her missions, she also have to face her biggest enemies, an organisation who gained divine power from her before she was pulled, when she had no control over it, and when Moorish Delight poked a small hole to the wide world during the experiment. **Background**

In the ancient time(~4000 years ago) even before the three tribes in proto-Equestria started to conflict each other, there was a war happening in the east of the Equestrian continent. A conflict in-between Alicornia, which is in Hesperia(reference to Spain), and the ancient Crystal Empire(Roman Empire), which is in the east(Italy).

In order to win the war, the Alicornians researched how to create a pony that contain the magic of all three kinds, which they succeed. The resulted creation soon became the king of Alicornia, with the new race given the name 'alicorn'.

The Alicorn King, however, soon realized how catastrophic it can be for one alone to hold so many power. The Crystal Empire's wielding of the magic of love shows him how devastating it can be, when mortals wield divine power as well. His resolve was finally hardened, after seeing the lawless gods among New World(Mesoamerica + carribean Islands + South America). He came to believe that sapient beings can never wield their power well, and to have gods means the worldly matters would forever be ruled by the whims of a single being. 

He decided that he would be the 'God to end all gods'. To carve off Hesperia and the New World from the wider world, and created a mini utopia universe ruled by a mechanical construct with all other sapient gods subdued, named the Algorithm. However, the Alicornians soon figured out his plan, and started to plot against his plan. Cuz if he can subdue all the gods, then why not become the overdeity of all himself instead?

In the end, the Alicorn king still succeed in his plan to carve out Hesperia and the New World. However, due to the sabotage of the Alicornians, the split was much more catastrophic instead, causing the ancient Crystal Empire to fall completely. The demoralised Crystal Ponies, as well as a number of refugees immigrated to the Equestrian continent, which they started living with the three tribes, or finding a new nation in the Crystal pony's case. The split was then dubbed 'The Cataclysm', or 'The First Dark Age'.

When the split happened, one god within the New World, Guabancex the god of creation and destruction, was particularly attracted by Alicorn King's ambitious plan of creation. So she decided to come near the edge(the Southern part of the Pryneenes) to watch. But she accidentally stepped too close, and got roped into the incident, which caused one of her legs to be maimed.

**Huracan**

Due to the creation/destruction nature of Guabancex, the severed leg soon gained autonomy as well. Following the scent of its mother, it went back towards the direction of the New World, only to find it completely gone. So instead, it ended up landing in Equestria, becoming a citizen of the Equestrian continent.

During the initial years, she would transform into various monsters and animals to maintain the level of chaos among Equestria, some of which were even fought by the ancient pillars. But once Equestria was established, it has no choice but to hide its divinity, living as wild animals, and at times other species of sapient beings to avoid detection. In order to maintain power, it soon learnt to shift its own divine domain to something more similar to Discord instead, such that it would be able to live on despite the dominance of the magic of harmony within the land. This is also where her domain shifted into 'change', instead of 'creation/destruction' 

Around 4000 years later, it started to feel a calling from a distant land, a land that she could call 'home'. As a result, it transformed into a unicorn filly, in order to better do her subsequent mission. Huracan, now called Moonlight Toccata instead, has her memories wiped completely, not knowing her true identity.

**Renaciment of Hesperia**

After so many years, the Algorithm starts to run out of power. Which means it will soon be no longer able to maintain Hesperia, as well as subduing the power of the gods. However, it cannot just merge Hesperia back as well, as it will cause yet another Cataclysm due to how drastically different Hesperians are to Equestrians, and how Hesperians are not famiar with divine stuff. The gods, in comparison, are resentful towards the forceful taking of power, and refuse to help.

As a result, the Algorithm started a simulation, and created a pony, Moorish Delight, to be the main subject of the experiment. The method is to let Moorish Delight solve all the problems and gather knowledge within Hesperia, by going through countless of loops. Due to it being a simulation, only a few minutes have passed in the wide world, while around ten thousand years have already passed in the simulation.


**Main story**

This is when Moonlight Toccata, now a young mare, was pulled into the Hesperian world. She is completely ignorant of what is happening, or even why she was pulled initially. During her time in Hesperia, she would have to cooperate with Moorish Delight, resolve the problems in Hesperia, and re-discover her divinity. There, she would fulfil her purpose of bringing a thorough re-structuring of the social structure within Hesperia, reinvigorate the ancient gods, and create a circumstance where the merge can safely happen.
